newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto sets Sept 1 chemical spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto sets Sept 1 chemical spin-off.

text.p: Monsanto Co said Monday it will spin off its chemical business as an independent company named Solutia Inc, which will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol SOI.

Monsanto said its life sciences businesses, which will retain the Monsanto name, will continue to trade under the MTC symbol. Monsanto's life sciences operations include agricultural, food additive and pharmaceutical businesses.

"Even though the name Monsanto isn't new, the concept of a life sciences industry is," Robert Shapiro, chairman, said in a statement. "We hope to capture the essence of our role in this emerging industry in our new positioning."

Solutia will own and operate businesses that produced $3.0 billion in sales in 1996. These businesses include man-made fibers, plastic interlayer for laminated glass, phosphorus-based food ingredients and performance products, high performance specialty chemicals, and chemicals intermediates.

Robert Potter, who has been acting chief executive of the chemical operations, will be chairman and chief executive officer of Solutia. He has been an executive vice president at Monsanto and an advisory director of the company.

Monsanto said that Solutia will rank among the top 25 chemical manufacturers in the United States, with total sales large enough to earn a spot in the Fortune 500. About 35 percent of the company's sales will come from markets outside of the United States.

Solutia will own trademarks such as Wear-Dated for carpet fiber and upholstery, Saflex plastic interlayer used in automotive windshields and other laminated glass, and Acrilan for acrylic fiber used in apparel, upholstery and craft yarns.

Solutia will own and operate 19 manufacturing plants worldwide, including facilities in 12 different states and in Belgium, Canada and the United Kingdom. At the time of the spin-off, Solutia will have about 8,800 employees worldwide.
Last week, Monsanto said its directors voted a dividend of one share of common stock in Solutia for each five shares of Monsanto. The record date for the spin-off will be August 20.
